content.tex: This is another method to count squares in rectangles.

Step A Multiply the width by the length of the rectangle 1st product Step B Subtract 1 from the width and 1 from the length and multiply 2nd product Step C Repeat step B until the width is 1 Step D Add together all the products

Step A \(3\times 5\) 1st product \(= 15\) Step B \((3-1) \times (5-1) = 2\times 4\) 2nd product \(= 8\) Step C \((2-1) \times (4-1) = 1\times 3\) 3rd product \(= 3\) Width is now 1 so move to step D Step D \(15+8+3 = 26\)
